content.text:
A normal paraffin with a molecular weight of 186.05 grams per mole has an estimated boiling
point of 149.02 degrees Celsius.

A normal paraffin with a molecular weight of 149.02 grams per mole has an estimated boiling
point of 186.05 degrees Celsius.

molecular weight of 149.02 grams per mole and an estimated boiling point of 186.05 degrees
Celsius.

molecular weight of 149.02 grams per mole and an estimated boiling point of 186.05 degrees
Celsius.
